help.a1: The Root Scan is a 4-step visual check (your hair story, photo capture, root-cause scan, and a visual Root Map). A dermatologist reviews it and writes your personal plan — the scan itself does not diagnose anything.
help.q2: When do I get my hair plan?
help.a2: After you submit your Root Scan, a dermatologist reviews it (usually within 48 hours). Your approved plan — habits, kits, and check-ups — then appears on the Plan page.
help.q3: How do I pay for a kit?
help.a3: We accept eSewa, Khalti, and cash on delivery (COD). You can track every order from the Orders page, and reorder a delivered kit in one tap.
help.a4: Your plan shows a rescan due date — usually every 8–12 weeks. Logging daily check-ins keeps your progress accurate; if your rescan is overdue, a reminder appears at the top of your Plan page.
help.q5: What are the daily check-ins for?
help.a5: Daily check-ins (shedding estimate + a short note) build your adherence record so your coach and dermatologist can see how the plan is working. They are a habit log, not a medical measurement.
